versions.subject: Merge PR #5385 from @CheraghiMilad - Added new tool for recording audio - ecasound
versions.detection:
selection_execve:
    type: EXECVE
    a0: arecord
    a1: '-vv'
    a2: '-fdat'
selection_syscall_memfd_create:
    type: SYSCALL
    exe|endswith: "/ecasound"
    syscall: 319
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (type="EXECVE" a0="arecord" a1="-vv" a2="-fdat") OR (type="SYSCALL" exe="*/ecasound" syscall=319)
